oauthApplications.title: OAuth Applications
oauthApplications.description: Register third-party applications that use AxonHub as their identity provider (OIDC).
oauthApplications.fields.name: Name
oauthApplications.fields.descriptionPlac: What this application is used for

oauthApplications.fields.clientIdHint: Client ID cannot be changed after creation.

oauthApplications.dialogs.create.title: New OAuth application
